name: knowledge:add
detail: zk-card add via lm-studio/google/gemma-4-26b-a4b-qat successfully created an atomic Zettelkasten note. The agent ran a 4-layer duplicate-check protocol (obsidian_search + obsidian_query, all ok) then created the note via obsidian_create. A new note exists under the vault's Zettelkasten folder and its body contains "ZK-CRUD-0001". CLI exited 0.

name: knowledge:find

name: knowledge:update
detail: zk-card update smart-merged new content into ZK-CRUD-0001.md. The new token "ZK-CRUD-0002" was appended (count=2, present in both the appended body line and the frontmatter sources field), while the original "ZK-CRUD-0001" content was preserved (count=1). Both grep conditions satisfied: ZK-CRUD-0002 >= 1 (merged) AND ZK-CRUD-0001 >= 1 (not overwritten). Exit code 0.

name: knowledge:check
detail: zk-card check completed with EXIT=0, producing a non-empty vault-health audit (health rating, orphan notes, dead links, missing frontmatter, duplicates check). No stack trace. The obsidian_garden subagent ran 4 tool calls in ~21s and returned a structured diagnosis in Traditional Chinese.

name: knowledge:remove
detail: zk-card remove executed the safe-delete protocol on Zettelkasten/ZK-CRUD-0001.md: it read the note, ran a backlink check (found no inbound links), and invoked obsidian_delete. Exit code 0, no stack trace, and the file is GONE.

name: bad-type-flag

name: slug-traversal-safety
detail: slugify is traversal-safe. It first calls basename() (strips all directory components, removing any "/"), then replaces non-[a-zA-Z0-9._-] runs with "-" and trims. None of the four adversarial inputs produced a slug containing "/" or exactly "..". EXIT=0.

name: dpi-invalid
detail: All four invalid --dpi values are rejected up front with exit code 1 and a clean "Invalid --dpi" error message. No stack-trace lines (no/^\s+at / matches). Rejection occurs before any rasterization or VLM work since the error surfaces immediately from CLI argument validation (no output directories created, no PDF processing). graceful = true.

name: directory-input
detail: vlm-describe exits non-zero (1) with a clear "Input is not a regular file" message and no stack trace when given a directory. Graceful failure confirmed.

name: corrupt-pdf
detail: vlm-describe fails gracefully on both corrupt PDFs. empty.pdf (0 bytes) exits 1 with "error: pdf2png failed (exit 3): cannot open ...". bogus.pdf (fake PK magic) exits 1 with "error: pdf2png failed (exit 3): ... cannot open ...". Both mention pdf2png failed / cannot open, both exit non-zero, neither prints a stack-trace line (no "    at " lines).
